en.name: Oracle
en.ability: Each night*, you learn how many dead players are evil.
en.flavor: Only the chosen may gaze beyond the veil. The dead are restless, and they point in silence toward the icy north.

revisions.v1: Each night*, you learn how many dead players are evil.
